submit_slurm_job: submit a SLURM job with specified nodes and eval config using sbatch
run_submit_ablation: run the script with --nodes and --eval_config arguments to submit an ablation evaluation job
parse_cli_args: parse command line arguments for nodes count and eval config name
review_main: review the main function that validates args and generates a SLURM script for multi-node evaluation
refactor_slurm_script: refactor the SLURM script template to customize resource allocation and environment setup
